Hi Sasha — thanks again for running through your procurement cadence earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a PR in flight for the evaluation PoC: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: 6-week PoC to validate latency/cost on a representative workload.
- Commercial path discussed: Acorn prefers PO for enterprise purchases; small POCs sometimes go on card.
- Procurement system: Coupa (Acorn will require Redwood to be an approved supplier or accept a marketplace purchase if available).

Action items for Acorn:
1) Confirm whether procurement will create a supplier profile (preferred) or use AWS Marketplace for this PoC.
2) If supplier profile, share required vendor form + any field-level requirements for PR lines (account codes, cost center, GL codes).
3) Target PR submission date (you mentioned early Dec).

Action items for Redwood:
- I will loop in our Sales Ops to confirm the exact supplier data we can provide (W9, bank details, contact, sample invoice lines).
- Prepare a one-page PR-ready cost estimate and a fillable supplier form for you to attach to the PR.

Attachments: I’m attaching a draft PR template and a short supplier-form we can fill out once you confirm required fields.

Proposed timing: If we get the supplier form this week, Marissa can prepare the vendor packet and we can aim for a PR submission by the week of 12/6. If Acorn wants to use card for a short pilot we can discuss that too.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_supplier_form_fillable.pdf (fillable supplier profile: tax id, remit address, banking, contact)
Attachment: Acorn_PR_template_v2.xlsx (sample PR line items and suggested descriptions)

Rishi — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We do use Coupa. For third-party software we prefer the vendor be onboarded as a supplier so POs can be generated. Marketplace purchases are possible but require pre-approval and tend to add extra steps for our finance team.
- I attached the standard vendor packet we need completed (fields include legal name, W9, remit address, primary contact, 1099 flag). We also need a sample invoice and the proposed PR line items (description + qty + unit price + GL code).
- For the PoC, our procurement sponsor Tim Wu prefers PO but is open to card for a sub-$5k pilot. He asked that we size the PoC so it can be either a single-line PR or a short-term card expense.

We’ll start the supplier request in Coupa once we receive the completed vendor packet and sample invoice. Target from our side: initiate supplier request 12/1 and PR submission by 12/8.

Attachments: Acorn_vendor_packet_required_fields.pdf

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Tim and will let you know if procurement needs anything else.

Best,
